Name: Game Chest - Logic Games
Description: A collection of pen-and-paper logic puzzles in one package.

Achievements.Name: Not Like This
Achievements.Description: Blow up in your first two moves, twice in a row, in Minesweeper.

Achievements.Name: Things Just Got Real
Achievements.Description: Uncover a six in Minesweeper.

Achievements.Name: Pawn Promotion
Achievements.Description: Promote a pawn to a queen in Chess.

Achievements.Name: Castling
Achievements.Description: Perform a castling move in Chess.

Achievements.Name: Unleaded

Achievements.Name: All Zeroes and Ones

Achievements.Name: P4wn'd!!11

Achievements.Name: Chimpanzee That!

Achievements.Name: What's Next?

Achievements.Name: You Go, Girl!

Achievements.Name: Ding!

Achievements.Name: Pop a Wheelie
